items.summary: President Donald Trump’s flight to Asia took a detour Monday as extreme weather forced Air Force One to change its Alaska refueling stop before continuing to the Philippines. Air Force One switched from Anchorage to Fairbanks to refuel under better weather conditions, a White House official confirmed to Fox News. The aircraft has since departed for Manila.
